source.stem:
The graph represents the motion of a train travelling between two stations.
0 100 200 300 400 500 600 700 800 900 Which statement about the train is correct?

options.text: Its acceleration takes a longer time than its deceleration.
It travels at constant speed for less than half of its journey time.
It travels 2000 m in the first 100 s.
It travels 10⁰⁰0 m at constant speed.

mx.name: condition_omission
mx.teacher_note: Every magnet, whatever its shape, attracts most strongly at its two ends.

mx.name: relationship_reversal
mx.teacher_note: A bar magnet attracts most strongly in the middle and least strongly at its two ends.

intelligence.enrichment: A magnet does not attract magnetic materials equally at all parts; most iron filings stick near its two poles, and only a few stick to the remaining parts. position on the magnet determines strength of attraction observed with iron filings The learner identifies the poles, near the two ends of a bar magnet, as the places where attraction is strongest. A magnet should pull equally from every part because the whole object is a magnet.
